description:
Delivery (`sent` · `link_given` · `expired` · `failed`) and the owner’s outcome (`declined` · `other_time` + proposal · `available` = free but NOT booked · `confirmed` = booked). `confirmed: true` only when the owner booked it.
`wait_seconds` (optional, default 0 = answer now; at most 45 s are used): waits for the owner and returns as soon as the request is answered or final, otherwise the current status when the wait ends (see `wait.ended`).
Waiting is not a promise of an answer, and nothing calls you back afterwards: if it is still waiting, call request_status again later (for example when the person asks). Hanging up does not cancel the request.
Follow the server instructions «HOW TO USE THE SUVERSE CATALOG»: results are candidates, not proof; keep reading, quoting, requesting and ordering separate; nothing is sent to an owner, booked, ordered or paid without the user’s permission.

wait_seconds.description: seconds to wait for the owner's answer (0–60, default 0; at most 45 are used)

name: request_status
title: What became of a request to the owner: delivery and the owner’s outcome
